entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: function %s is not a recognized lowering target

guard: past exhaustive switch c.Func.Name over [case "absent"; case "clamp", "clamp_min", "clamp_max"; case "histogram_quantile"; case "histogram_quantiles"; case fnLabelReplace; case fnLabelJoin; case "info"; case "time"; case "vector"; case "year", "month", "day_of_month", "day_of_week", "day_of_year", "days_in_month", "hour", "minute", timestampFunctionName; case "sort", "sort_desc"; case "sort_by_label", "sort_by_label_desc"; case "scalar", fnMinOf, fnMaxOf; case "start", "end"; case "pi"]
past returning if chFn, ok := instantFnCH[c.Func.Name]; ok

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: function %s() requires query range context (use LowerAt)
entries.rationale: Only Lower, the one lowering entry with no request range, leaves a start() or end() call for this arm. LowerAtRangeOpts, which LowerAt and LowerAtRange call and which the PromQL HTTP query endpoints lower through with the request's start and end, runs preprocessQuery first, and it folds every start() and end() call to a NumberLiteral holding the request's bound, so none reaches lowerCall there. Lower has no caller outside tests; LowerMetadataRange and lowerMetadataCatalog lower bare selectors only. lowerSubqueryOverInstantCall and lowerSubqueryOverInstantTransform hand lowerCall calls from the same already-preprocessed tree.
